title: Essentially constant cofiltered pro-diagram
statement: Let $J$ be a cofiltered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, and $G:J\to\mathcal C$ a functor. We say that $G$ is *essentially constant with value $X$ as a pro-object* if there are morphisms $u_j:X\to G(j)$ natural in $j$ (a cone), an index $j_0$ and a morphism $r:G(j_0)\to X$ with $r\circ u_{j_0}=\mathrm{id}_X$, and such that for every $j$ there is an index $k$ with morphisms $k\to j_0$ and $k\to j$ in $J$ for which the transition map $G(k)\to G(j)$ equals the composite $G(k)\to G(j_0)\xrightarrow{r}X\xrightarrow{u_j}G(j)$, the first map being induced by the chosen morphism $k\to j_0$. This is the dual of [def-pc-essentially-constant-ind-diagram].
